heading: Who Am I?
description: Senior UI engineer with {years} of experience building web applications that have to stay fast under real traffic. I started out on e-commerce storefronts and now work on enterprise travel platforms at JP Morgan Chase. The job hasn't really changed in that time: take a complicated set of business requirements and turn it into something people can use without stopping to think about it.

Most of my work is Angular, React, and TypeScript on the front end, with Node.js and REST APIs behind it, though I'm strongest in the part users actually see. Across ten-plus enterprise applications, that has meant design systems and shared component libraries, JWT authentication, travel booking and order management flows used by thousands of people a day, and accessibility built in from the start rather than patched in before release.

The longer I do this, the clearer it gets that the code is rarely the hard part. I now spend as much time on architecture decisions, code reviews, and mentoring as I do writing features, because the standards you set around performance and testing are what keep a codebase healthy long after the sprint that shipped it.
